sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 1m
facts: Raster terrain model covering about 99% of England at 1 m spatial resolution
Surface objects are removed to produce a bare-earth terrain model
Newest best-resolution repeat surveys are used and resampled data uses bilinear interpolation
Native horizontal CRS is EPSG:27700 and published vertical accuracy is ±15 cm RMSE
sources.limit: Composite cells can originate from different survey dates; ±15 cm RMSE is not a parcel-specific 95% interval

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 2m
facts: Independent 2 m composite DTM contract
Same bare-earth surface semantics and national-grid reference family
Used here only to test sensitivity of the 1 m parcel span
sources.limit: The 2 m product cannot replace the pinned 1 m primary measurement

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
facts: Time-stamped terrain archive preserves survey-specific lineage
Historic resolutions can include 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m
Survey date, transformation and geoidal model remain material
sources.limit: Historical tiles require explicit date and datum handling before any numeric comparison

sources.name: INSPIRE technical guidance for GML files
facts: HMLR polygons are captured against British National Grid
Native CRS is EPSG:27700
BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection may shift some features by up to 15 m
sources.limit: Exact containment and sampling remain native EPSG:27700; WGS84 coordinates are display-only

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 Technical Specification
facts: OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution digital terrain model
Grid data has regular 50 m post spacing
Grid and contour forms are supplied in 10 km by 10 km National Grid tiles
sources.limit: The product is suitable for landscape-scale analysis, not primary sub-metre parcel measurement

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 grid-data specification
facts: ASCII tiles contain 200 rows by 200 columns
Each pixel is 50 m by 50 m
Height values are calculated from pixel centres and supplied to the nearest 0.1 m
The GML sidecar carries location, grid spacing and vertical-reference metadata
sources.limit: Header and cell semantics verify transport structure but not the correctness of a sampled parcel value

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 metadata specification
facts: Per-tile XML metadata follows the GEMINI standard
Metadata identifies product, spatial representation and 10 km tile reference
Metadata is provided for national products and per-tile supplies
sources.limit: Metadata proves lineage context but does not substitute for archive, ASC and PRJ byte hashes

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 source-data semantics
facts: Grid and contours are interpolated from a source TIN
X/Y coordinates are OSGB36 Eastings/Northings
Z is height relative to the applicable datum
Buildings and vegetation are excluded from the bare-earth surface
sources.limit: TIN and bare-earth semantics do not improve the published 50 m spacing or 4 m RMSE

sources.name: OGC Web Coverage Service standard
facts: WCS retrieves multidimensional geospatial coverages over the Internet
Core requirements are mandatory for conformant implementations
CRS, scaling, interpolation and encoding behaviours are defined by separate extensions
sources.limit: Standards conformance alone does not prove that a particular endpoint returned correct parcel values

sources.name: WCS 2.0.1 executable compliance test suite
facts: The suite tests GetCapabilities and DescribeCoverage
GetCoverage KVP binding is covered
Core, scaling, interpolation, range-subsetting and CRS classes are checked separately
sources.limit: The generic suite defines validation expectations; it is not evidence that the EA endpoint was certified by this suite
